title: 岔路
text:
{char}又被送进来了，这一次更深一点，手里只有一把{item:knife}。

这片废墟的路会分岔。临走前军团的人塞给你一支{item:spyglass} —— 它不占背包，是你的一种本事：{b}把鼠标移到地图上的点上{/b}，会浮出那个点的情报：战斗点写着对手带了什么、多少血、大概多少输出，用过的点写着已经空了。看清楚再选往哪边走 —— 岔路上的两个对手性子完全不同，带错东西会很难受。

先往前走到搜索点。

texts.en:
{char} is sent in again, a little deeper this time, with nothing but a {item:knife}.

The paths in these ruins fork. Before you left, someone from the Legion pressed a {item:spyglass} into your hand. It takes no room in your Pack; it's a skill. {b}Hover over a spot on the map{/b} and its intel pops up: a battle shows what the enemy carries, its Health and rough damage; a spot you've used shows it's empty. Look before you pick a direction. The two enemies at the fork are nothing alike, and the wrong gear will hurt.

First, head on to the search spot.
